disclaimer_privacy: Ingen personlige oplysninger eller enhedsoplysninger indsamles eller transmitteres nogensinde af denne app.
use_mbasic: Brug den grundlæggende version af Facebook
use_mbasic_desc: Det fungerer bedre på ældre enheder eller langsommere forbindelser
recent_first_desc: Works with the desktop site. Turn on "Use desktop site" to get the chronological feed.
send_to_dev_desc: Hvis koden er sikker og nyttig, vil den blive inkluderet i den næste udgivelse af appen
become_hero_desc: Få dit navn på listen over vigtige støtter
become_hero_desc_v1: Dit navn vil blive vist på listen over vigtige støtter
start_on_messenger_desc: Start på Messenger-skærmen i stedet for feedet. Messenger skal være slået til
text_zoom_desc: Skaler sidens tekst uden at ødelægge layoutet
hide_feed_desc: No posts on the home page. Notifications, groups, profiles and Messenger still work
error_page_offline: Facebook kunne ikke indlæses. Tjek din forbindelse, og prøv igen.
telemetry_reports_desc: Anonyme nedbruds- og fejlrapporter hjælper med at opdage, når en ændring på Facebook ødelægger appen. Der sendes ingen personlige data og intet sideindhold. Du kan slå det fra når som helst.
rate_subtitle: Tryk på en stjerne for at bedømme
rate_low_title: Det er vi kede af at høre
rate_sends_notice: Dette sender din besked til udvikleren sammen med appversionen, enhedsmodellen og Android-versionen. Din indstilling for fejlrapporter forbliver slået fra.
rate_failed: Kunne ikke sende. Prøv igen senere.
use_desktop_site_desc: Facebook's desktop layout. Use this if chat, share, or the feed overlay is broken
use_system_browser: Open links in the system browser
use_system_browser_desc: External links open in your browser app instead of the in-app tab
supporter_story: Every week about 10 companies email me to buy SlimSocial and fill it with ads and trackers. I say no to all of them. Your support keeps it free for everyone.
supporter_msg_large: You are a hero of the free web.
supporter_prices_failed: Prices could not load. Check your connection and try again.
supporter_renews: Renews every year until you cancel in Google Play.
supporter_payment_failed: Payment did not go through. You were not charged.
supporter_payment_pending: Your payment is pending. It will activate when Google confirms.
supporter_restore_none: No active support found on this Google account.
supporter_restore_failed: Could not reach Google Play. Try again later.
supporter_thanks_body: SlimSocial stays free and independent for another year. Not for sale.
supporter_manage_hint: Manage or cancel any time in Google Play › Subscriptions.
supporter_install_from_play: Install SlimSocial from Google Play to support it.
